- Tap the info button at the bottom of the screen, tap "Download Offline Rates."

- Tap the + sign on the iPhone/iPod, or tap Currencies on the iPad.

- Swipe to delete, tap edit and delete, or tap + and uncheck the currencies you wish to delete.
